namespaces.uiCopy: tab.quran, quran.chooseEdition; English semantic keys in copy/ar-MA.json
namespaces.theme: colors.<theme>.<semanticRole>; never mix raw hex with semantic keys
namespaces.devotional: devotional.<scope>.<permanent-ID>; never text or current array index

namespaces.database: roqia-metadata schemaVersion 2; future schema migrations monotonic
